subject: Re: Project Kestrel kickoff: ETC as our long-document encoder
body:
Dmitri,

Kestrel resourcing.

People: Jorge 70% on packaging, CI, and the adoption guide; Umar 50% on the fine-tuning reproduction; Tereza 40% on example generation and dataset plumbing. All Kestrel jobs are tagged kestrel-* on the cluster side per Dmitri's ask.

Compute: fine-tuning wants TPU - the repo's cloud-TPU path (cloud-tpu-client) maps cleanly onto Cirrus, and I've requested a slice from our data-platforms quarterly allocation for April. CI and unit tests run on CPU; note the tests assume the working directory is the parent of the etcmodel folder, which bit us on day one, so the CI image pins that.

Risk to flag early: the Cirrus April window is shared with two other portfolio requests, and if we're bumped, Umar's Apr 24 reproduction milestone moves roughly a week. I'll know by Mar 20.

Santiago
